chunks: Al-Ridha عليه السلام used to write on merchandise: “A blessing for us.”

key_terms.الرِّضَا: Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Ridha عليه السلام write on merchandise when purchasing goods for trade?
ai.summary: This report states that Imam al-Ridha عليه السلام would write a brief phrase of blessing on trade goods. It reflects seeking barakah from Allah in commercial dealings and preserves a practice associated with the Imam عليه السلام.
